## Research question
How does Glimmer compare with Trellis-RE across the three relation-extraction test sets, and what does the ablation show about the evidence-gating module?

## Methods summary
Glimmer is a document-level relation extractor that adds an evidence-gating module, which down-weights sentences judged irrelevant to an entity pair, on top of a Trellis-RE-style encoder. Trellis-RE is the main baseline. 'Glimmer w/o evidence gating' removes only the gating module. All systems are trained on Hollin-DocRE only.

## Experimental setup
Hollin-DocRE is the in-domain test set; Saltmarsh-Bio (biomedical) and Wistmoor-News (news) are out-of-domain test sets not used for training or tuning. Metric: relation F1 (%, higher is better), mean over 3 seeds; the seed standard deviation is at most 0.4 F1 for every entry.

## Experiments and comparisons
- `exp1`: Main comparison and ablation on three test sets
  - comparison `exp1/cmp1`: Glimmer (full) vs Trellis-RE: F1 per test set
  - comparison `exp1/cmp2`: Glimmer (full) vs Glimmer w/o evidence gating: F1 per test set (ablation)

## Results tables

Columns: `hollin` = Hollin-DocRE [unit: %] (higher is better); `salt` = Saltmarsh-Bio [unit: %] (higher is better); `wist` = Wistmoor-News [unit: %] (higher is better)

## Task
Write a short Results/Discussion passage (2–4 sentences) that answers the research question using only the evidence in this package.

sentences.text: Glimmer (full) achieves higher relation F1 than Trellis-RE on all three test sets, with gains of 3.4 points on Hollin-DocRE (65.2 vs 61.8), 3.6 points on Saltmarsh-Bio (55.9 vs 52.3), and 1.1 points on Wistmoor-News (71.1 vs 70.0).

The ablation shows that removing the evidence-gating module decreases F1 on Hollin-DocRE (65.2 to 63.0) and Saltmarsh-Bio (55.9 to 54.1), but increases F1 on Wistmoor-News (71.1 to 72.4), indicating a mixed effect across domains.
These results are descriptive only, as no statistical tests were reported.

Glimmer achieves higher mean F1 than Trellis-RE on all three test sets, with gains of 3.4 points on Hollin-DocRE (65.2 vs. 61.8), 3.6 points on Saltmarsh-Bio (55.9 vs. 52.3), and 1.1 points on Wistmoor-News (71.1 vs. 70.0).

The ablation shows that removing the evidence-gating module reduces F1 on Hollin-DocRE and Saltmarsh-Bio (from 65.2 to 63.0 and from 55.9 to 54.1, respectively), but increases F1 on Wistmoor-News by 1.3 points (from 71.1 to 72.4), indicating that the gating module's benefit is not universal.
All systems were trained only on Hollin-DocRE, so the out-of-domain results on Saltmarsh-Bio and Wistmoor-News should be interpreted with that scope in mind.
No statistical significance tests were reported, so the observed differences should be interpreted with caution.

Glimmer outperforms Trellis-RE on all three test sets, with F1 gains of 3.4 points on Hollin-DocRE (65.2 vs. 61.8), 3.6 points on Saltmarsh-Bio (55.9 vs. 52.3), and 1.1 points on Wistmoor-News (71.1 vs. 70.0).

The ablation shows that removing the evidence-gating module reduces F1 on Hollin-DocRE and Saltmarsh-Bio (from 65.2 to 63.0 and from 55.9 to 54.1, respectively), but slightly increases F1 on Wistmoor-News (from 71.1 to 72.4).

These results are based on mean F1 over three seeds with standard deviations at most 0.4, and no statistical significance tests were reported, so the observed differences should be interpreted with caution.
